title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Call Class Schedule Card
content:
Each of the six call classes of Repair and Emergency Service Calls runs on its own days and clock hours (Eastern time), offers its own arrival windows and accepts bookings up to its own cut-off. The schedule below is the reference for every class; a class applies only on its service days and within its service hours.

## Schedule by call class

| Call class | Service days | Service hours | Arrival windows offered | Booking cut-off | Furthest ahead it can be scheduled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | Mon-Fri | 08:00-17:00 | 08:00-12:00 and 12:00-17:00 | 17:00 on the prior business day | 30 calendar days |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | Mon-Fri | 08:00-17:00 | 08:00-12:00 and 12:00-17:00 | 12:00 on the same weekday | 0 days (current day only) |
| Evening Service Call | Mon-Fri | 17:00-22:00 | 17:00-22:00 | 20:00 on the same weekday | 14 calendar days |
| Weekend Service Call | Sat-Sun | 08:00-17:00 | 08:00-12:00 and 12:00-17:00 | 17:00 on the prior day | 21 calendar days |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | Every night | 22:00-08:00 | 22:00-08:00 | 06:00 within the same night | 0 days (current night only) |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | Company holidays | 00:00-24:00 | 08:00-12:00, 12:00-17:00, 17:00-22:00 and 22:00-08:00 | none | 0 days (current day only) |

## Dispatch settings by call class

| Call class | Response target for a no-heat or no-cool call | Comfort Club scheduling priority orders the queue | Technician pool dispatched | Open calls one unit may hold at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | 72 hours | Yes | Service technician | 1 |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | 8 hours | Yes | Service technician | 1 |
| Evening Service Call | 6 hours | Yes | On-call technician | 1 |
| Weekend Service Call | 24 hours | Yes | Service technician | 1 |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | 4 hours | No | On-call technician | 1 |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | 4 hours | No | On-call technician | 1 |

## Reading the card

- **Furthest ahead** is counted in calendar days from the booking date. A figure of 0 means only the current day or night can be booked in that class.
- **Response target** is the target elapsed time, in whole hours, from booking to the technician's arrival on a no-heat or no-cool call in that class.
- **Scheduling priority orders the queue** records whether the Comfort Club tier's scheduling priority decides the order of the dispatch queue in that class. In the Overnight Emergency and Holiday Emergency classes it does not.
- **Open calls per unit** is the number of calls in booked or dispatched status that one unit may have at the same time.

## Worked readings (hypothetical bookings)

- A Standard Service Call booked on a Monday may be scheduled for any weekday window up to 30 calendar days after that Monday. A date 31 days out is beyond the class's reach.
- An Evening Service Call booked on a Tuesday may be scheduled up to 14 calendar days ahead. Every evening booking has the single 17:00-22:00 window.
- A Same-Day Priority Service Call and an Overnight Emergency Service Call cannot be scheduled for a later day, because their figure is 0.
